pagerbot: :rotating_light: PD Alert fired: PD#78945 — inference-service (eu-west-1) 5xx spike (rate: 7% -> 18%)
incidentbot: Auto-escalation: primary oncall did not ack in 90s, paging rotation active. @alex, @maria next in rotation.
maria: Acked. I'm on it — joining bridge now. Can someone post recent deploys? :coffee:
alex: saw a small config push to autoscaler at 03:15 UTC from ci/cd. Not sure if related.
amy (ops): FYI customer-facing metrics show increased 5xx for a handful of high-retry tenants. Customers: partner-a, search-inc.
pagerbot: Relevant runbook: inference-5xx-spike -> recommend rolling restart of gateway pool if error ratio > 10% for 5m.
maria: checking /metrics and logs. KV cache evictions jumped. Possible memory pressure on gateway pods.
alex: I'm running a quick grep on logs, looks like grpc handshake errors from dedicated-pool nodes. Posting snippet:
```
ERROR 2026-03-17T03:18:10Z grpc: recv failure: connection reset by peer
```
sam: If dedicated pool is flapping, we should route traffic to fallback model-variant and reduce pipeline concurrency. Can we trigger routing override?
maria: I can flip routing to fallback-variant-eu now. Will also scale gateway replicas +2. Doing both in console.
incidentbot: maria executed routing.override -> fallback-variant-eu (scope: eu-west-1).
maria: Scaling gateways: replicas 6 -> 8.
alex: Noted. I'll open a short customer impact note: "We are investigating increased 5xx in EU; mitigation in progress (fallback routing + scaling)." Want me to ping Sales?
jordan: Yes please — loop in sales-ops for partner-a and search-inc. I can draft.
sam: Post-check in ~2m. If 5xx rate drops under 5% for 3 consecutive 1m windows, we can keep routing and not restart nodes. If not, plan for targeted gateway restart.
maria: 1m after routing change: 5xx -> 9.5% (down from 18%). KV evictions dropping. Looks promising.
alex: Good. I'm holding off restarts unless we see >10% again.
incidentbot: Alert suppressed (auto) — conditions improving. Will keep thread open for followups.
maria: Team — I'll monitor for 30m, then revert to original routing gradually if stable.
jordan: Draft sent to sales-ops with the mitigation note.
sam: Thanks — adding a TODO to post-mortem: investigate autoscaler config that coincided with deploy.
maria: Adding runbook step: check pool memory headroom and set eviction threshold higher.
pagerbot: PD Alert resolved (automatic) at ts 3032101286.
maria: Resolving here — leaving notes in #postmortems/incidents. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
